title: Black Bean and Mango Salad
description: All you need for this easy summer salad are black beans, tomatoes, mango, avocado, and cilantro. It is seasoned with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
ingredients: 2 (15 ounce) cans black beans, drained and rinsed, or more to taste
2 yellow mango - peeled, pitted, and cubed
2 tomatoes, chopped, or more to taste
0.25 cup chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Combine black beans, avocados, mango, tomatoes, red onion, and cilantro in a large bowl. Pour lemon juice on top and season with salt and pepper. Mix until well combined.
